name: EPIC 249669157

text.card: A red giant 7,911 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 2.65 solar masses and 17.5 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 5,116 K at its surface.
